nodes.title: kon/place replaces kon/set for c6-maths-ch02-t03: the child places a LOOSE protractor (drag the body; turn it by a handle on its body about its own centre, 1° snap in the law; 'Rakh do' locks it) and then measures ∠AOB (taps a number on the outer or inner band, ±1), draws ∠AOB = θ on OA (a dot on the rim, joined to O or to A), or (size) says which of two angles under a big and a small protractor is more. Placement passes when the centre is within tolPx = 8 board px of O and the base line is within ±3° of an arm (for measure, with the other arm crossing the half-disc). The reading (and draw's mark) is graded on the protractor AS PLACED (the scale whose 0 sits on the placed arm), and a placement that is off never solves: a misplaced protractor read correctly is vertex-off (the bottom edge on O: the centre PD = 20 board px off O along the normal), else a refusal. Mal-rules vertex-off, wrong-scale, join-wrong-end, tool-size, each with its own signature in the moment ('shown'): the arm the misplaced protractor measures drawn from its centre beside OB; her number's arm on the 0-on-the-arm scale; the angle made at A with its number; both readings side by side. Evidence: grade.facts placed (the FIRST decision's placement) / centre_px / base_deg / read, and the lesson's facts row leads with placed=ok|off (server/play/routes.js seamLead). Coverage: draw [s3, s2, s1], measure [s2, s1], size [s2] (s1 IS placing the protractor, so it is admitted here although the design note named s3, s2). Reverse if: a child pilot shows children cannot drag the protractor to within 8 px on a phone (placement misses with no belief named above ~30%), or judges call the scale tap a pick from a list.

kon/place draws on a fixed 320 × 340 board (y up) the view scales into its box; acts carry board coordinates, so the server replays a placement on any device. At a 360 px phone the play canvas is about 360 × 350 (harness play mode) and the protractor (radius 105) is 216 px wide; the turning handle sits ON the body (half way up, at the scale's 90), because a handle hanging below the base fell off the canvas at rest; a small protractor (size, radius 78) numbers its inner scale every 60° (every 30° the numbers touched: Q3.apart at p360 in the first cert run). Controls keep two rows in every state so the board never rescales between placing and reading. Reverse if: the stage contract's p360 box shrinks below 330 px of canvas height (the protractor then falls under 200 px), or a phone pilot shows the on-body handle is grabbed when the child means to move the protractor.
